definitions.explanation: The opening phase of a time period such as a century, decade, year, or month. Typically attaches to a time word to specify the early portion.

examples.japanese: 20⟦{世紀|せいき}→世紀：03373_seiki⟧{初頭|しょとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ことだ。
examples.english: It was at the beginning of the 20th century.

examples.japanese: 2000⟦{年代|ねんだい}→年代：03533_nendai⟧{初頭|しょとう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦インターネット→インターネット：04723_intaanetto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{急速|きゅうそく}→急速：02634_kyuusoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{普及|ふきゅう}した→普及する：22182_fukyuusuru⟧。
examples.english: The internet spread rapidly in the early 2000s.

examples.japanese: ⟦{明治|めいじ}{時代|じだい}→明治時代：28080_meijijidai⟧{初頭|しょとう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{近代化|きんだいか}→近代化：15055_kindaika⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|あゆ}み→歩む：13196_ayumu⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: At the beginning of the Meiji era, Japan started on the path to modernization.

notes:
{初頭|しょとう} means the beginning or early part of a time period. Composed of ⟦{初|しょ}→初〜：03955_sho⟧ (first, beginning) + ⟦{頭|とう}→頭：18067_tou⟧ (head). Almost always follows a time-period noun.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{世紀|せいき}→世紀：03373_seiki⟧{初頭|しょとう}: beginning of a century
- ⟦{年代|ねんだい}→年代：03533_nendai⟧{初頭|しょとう}: beginning of a decade
- ⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧{初頭|しょとう}: beginning of the year
- 21⟦{世紀|せいき}→世紀：03373_seiki⟧{初頭|しょとう}: early 21st century
- 2000⟦{年代|ねんだい}→年代：03533_nendai⟧{初頭|しょとう}: early 2000s

REGISTER:
Used in written and formal contexts — news, academic writing, history. Rarely used in casual conversation.

TIME PERIOD TERMS:
- {初頭|しょとう}: beginning (formal)
- ⟦{中頃|なかごろ}→中頃：11379_nakagoro⟧: middle
- ⟦{後半|こうはん}→後半：12555_kouhan⟧: latter half
- {末|まつ}/⟦{末期|まっき}→末期：13032_makki⟧: end

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{冒頭|ぼうとう}→冒頭：11725_boutou⟧: opening, beginning (of a speech, book, etc. — not time periods)
- ⟦{当初|とうしょ}→当初：12503_tousho⟧: initially, at first
